content: In Obadiah, which nation is the vision about?
explanation: God spoke against its pride. “This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom” (Obadiah 1:1, BSB)

content: In Obadiah, what had deceived Edom?
explanation: They thought no one could bring them down. “The pride of your heart has deceived you” (Obadiah 1:3, BSB)

content: In Obadiah, Edom soared like which bird?
explanation: God would still bring it down. “Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars” (Obadiah 1:4, BSB)

content: In Obadiah, where did Edom's people live?
options: In the clefts of the rocks
explanation: Their home was in the heights. “O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks whose habitation is the heights” (Obadiah 1:3, BSB)

content: In Obadiah, what will happen to Edom as it has done to others?
options: It will be done to it
explanation: The Day of the LORD is near. “As you have done, it will be done to you” (Obadiah 1:15, BSB)

content: In Obadiah, among what did proud Edom make its nest?
explanation: Even from there God would bring it down. “and make your nest among the stars, even from there I will bring you down” (Obadiah 1:4, BSB)
